text.p: The average yields at auctions of six-, nine-, and 12-month yields slipped from the last sale on February 20, a central bank statement said on Friday.
Six-month bills slipped to 33.33 percent from 33.90 percent, nine-month bills edged down to 35.69 percent from 36.99 percent and 12-month bills fell to 38.63 percent from 38.65 percent.
The results of Friday's six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 17.00 million UAH no limit
Amount sold 17.00 million UAH 31.10 million UAH
Actual amount raised 14.58 million UAH 26.61 million UAH
The central bank sold 170,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 112,330 were competitive and 57,670 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for February 25.
The results of nine-month discount T-bills auction, compared to last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 25 million UAH no limit
Amount sold 24.69 million UAH 35.62 million UAH
Actual amount raised 19.49 million UAH 27.90 million UAH
The central bank sold 246,907 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 202,183 were competitive and 44,724 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for February 25.
The results of 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 35.00 million UAH no limit
Amount sold 15.93 million UAH 22.03 million UAH
Actual amount raised 11.49 million UAH 15.89 million UAH
The central bank sold 159,269 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 84,487 were competitive and 74,782 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for February 25.
